context: User reported the mobile on-screen keyboard covers the lower half of the rotated UI, making it impossible to reach the nickname field or login button after typing an email.
root_cause_found: Beyond the visual coverage, there was a real functional bug: a global keydown handler called interact() on every Enter keypress with no check for whether the user was typing in a text input. Pressing Enter while filling the login form also triggered a game interaction, disrupting the open modal.

fix.keyboard_chaining: Email field auto-focuses on modal open, has enterkeyhint=next, Enter moves focus to nickname. Nickname field has enterkeyhint=done, Enter submits login directly. The whole flow completes via the keyboard's own next/done key without needing to see or tap anything hidden behind it.
fix.global_keydown_guard: The global keydown handler now skips all game-key handling when the event target is an INPUT or TEXTAREA, fixing this for every text field in the game (login, DM chat, user search), not just login.

verification.keyboard_only_flow_tested: Simulated the full real-world sequence (auto-focus, type+Enter chains to nickname, type+Enter submits login) and confirmed the account was stored without a single button click.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, stuck-at-node escape test, speed-equalization test, and standard headless-browser playthrough all pass with only expected harmless local-sandbox errors.
